title: vim-companion observer fixture (spike S3)
description: Spike S2's grammar fixture format (s2/fixture-grammar.schema.json) with two extensions for the IntelliJ observer: the mode cmdline for an open : or / prompt, and an optional observer object per step. observer.prompt is the open prompt (: or /) or null; observer.recording is the register being recorded or null; observer.during lists the states in which T1 stays silent (macro, dot, mapping) that the observer must see while the key runs. A field left out of observer is not checked.
$comment: The extensions are checked by the S3 fixture runner; the S2 schema itself rejects them, so this file documents them rather than validating them.
